evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to 11.8 ppm; it has stayed at or below about 6 ppm since then.
Temperature overshot to 760.1°C when growth began, then settled within ±1°C of the 750°C setpoint.
Heater power has held steady at about 45% during growth, which fits the thermocouple reading.
Argon flow is steady at the 100 sccm setpoint.
Controller status is 'running' and the readings are changing, so the status does not look stale.

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so tube pressure cannot be checked directly. A seal leak or exhaust blockage can only be inferred from O2 and heater power. There is no characterization of the sample yet.
